traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS are implemented and verified by comprehensive tests and documentation. The two core rules, traceability/require-story-annotation and traceability/require-req-annotation, share the same function detection scope (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature) with arrow functions explicitly excluded by default, use robust and conceptually aligned JSDoc/comment parsing strategies, support configurable scope and exportPriority with shared semantics, report errors at precise function identifiers with clear and actionable messages, and fully support TypeScript-specific constructs. Rule documentation files exist with accurate descriptions, schemas, and examples. All related test suites that explicitly reference this story passed in the recorded Jest run. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED.
